\begin{abstract}
We interviewed twenty-four participants; 35\% of them used the tool daily.
A survey of 300 respondents found that 12.5\% did.
\end{abstract}
\maketitle
\section{Method}
We recruited 24 people at Example University (REB \#41234 approved the study).
As described in our previous work~\cite{anonymous2026}, the tool logs use.
We previously showed that logging works.
Materials are at \url{https://github.com/adaexample/study} and \url{https://osf.io/abcde/}.
Data are at \url{https://osf.io/abcde/?view_only=0123}, \anon{Example University}
and \anon{\url{https://github.com/adaexample/data}}; Example et al.~\cite{anonymous2026} is fine.
This work was funded by grant no. ABCD-0001.
\section{Results}
Of the participants, 34.8\% used the tool daily (\autoref{fig:use}).
